lens: Aster: honesty surface and maintainer tooling
title: Said vs Derived
tagline: A repo-wide scanner that finds display strings carrying literal dates, thresholds and unit-bearing numbers that duplicate a constant the code already owns, so DEC-17-5 is checked by a tool instead of by memory.
pitch: `node said-vs-derived.mjs <aster-checkout>` harvests canonical values (numeric exports under `src/v2/core/constants/`, the `metadata` block read from the first kilobytes of `lambert-screen-cache.json`, `GRID_PARAMS`-style object literals) and then walks `src/v2/app/**`, `src/v2/porkchop/**` and the HTML entry points for string and template literals. Each hit is classed DERIVED (value arrives through `${}`), LITERAL-MATCHES-CONSTANT (the literal equals a harvested constant, named with its home), LITERAL-DATE-SPAN, or LITERAL-WITH-UNITS, after excluding CSS (`rgba`, `px`, `%`), import specifiers and `console.*`. A second pass finds the same literal typed in several files. It prints a Markdown and JSON findings table and exits non-zero when findings exceed an explicit allowlist that must carry a reason per entry. Run against the checkout at 62ddb17 it reports: the porkchop span label is now derived (`main.ts:203`, `:647`) so the STATUS Slice 19 item is stale; `catalog-list/honesty-disclosure.ts:59` prints 'C3 ≤ 25 km²/s²' as a literal while `compare/main.ts:874,956` reads `metadata.feasibleC3MaxKm2S2` as DEC-17-5(a) requires; and the departure window `'2026-01-01'`/`'2040-01-01'` is independently typed in `porkchop/main.ts:195-196`, `ui-overlay/overlay.ts:160-161`, `porkchop-smoke/main.ts:65-66` and `compare/main.ts:106-107`, while the cache's `screeningWindow.endUtc` is 2040-12-31 (S17-F2, still unfixed).
whyNow: DEC-17-5 LOCKED, `SLICE_17_FOUNDING.md:197-209` (labels derived, rider (a): the 25 km²/s² threshold is a runtime read of metadata.feasibleC3MaxKm2S2, never a literal); STATUS.md:417-419 (Slice 19 item 1, the literal label as an honesty defect); STATUS.md:534 C16 S17-F2 (two spans both called '2026-2040'); INV-026 (`INVARIANTS.md:200`); BRIEFING §4: 'Linting tools that catch literal labels are wanted everywhere and exist nowhere'. Verified at 62ddb17: `src/v2/app/catalog-list/honesty-disclosure.ts:59` literal; four-file window literals as listed; `tests/v2-derived-span-labels.test.mjs` pins one label only.
computes: Inputs: checkout root, optional allowlist JSON. Harvest: regex over `export const NAME = <number>` in constants files; JSON.parse of the cache metadata (streamed first 4 KB, then the metadata object); object-literal fields named *Days, *Km2S2, *Utc, dep*/tof*. Scan: tokenises string/template literals in TS/HTML; inside templates, text in `${}` is DERIVED, text outside is literal. Matching: numeric tokens compared to harvested values after unit normalisation (km²/s² and km^2/s^2 equal); ISO dates and 'YYYY-YYYY' spans always reported. Duplicate pass: identical literal in >= 2 files. Output: table rows {file, line, literal, class, matchingConstant, constantHome}, duplicate groups, counts, exit code.
dataNeeded: None snapshotted for the tool; it reads a live checkout. For tests: a synthetic 6-file fixture tree (~5 KB) with known literal/derived/CSS/import cases. Optional: snapshot `tests/fixtures/v2/lambert-screen-cache.json` --pick metadata (1.2 KB) to show constant matching against the real threshold 25 and window end 2040-12-31 without the 34 MB file. The README's findings table cites file:line at 62ddb17 and is regenerated by the tool, never typed.
existingOverlap: `tests/v2-derived-span-labels.test.mjs` asserts by regex that one label in one file is templated; `tests/v2-validation-provenance.test.mjs` checks wording in one JSON; `compare/main.ts:874` documents one runtime read. There is no generic scanner and nothing detects the same literal typed in several files. The seed's named target (`main.ts:637`) is already fixed; the tool's value is the remaining findings and the regression guard.
honestyRisks: False positives are the main risk (a '25' in a style string, a year in a filename such as `horizons-inner-solar-system-2026-2040.json`); every finding shows the exact token in context and the tool never edits code. It does not prove a value is derived, only that a literal exists where a derived form is known elsewhere, and the README says so. Constant values are read live from the checkout, never retyped. The known findings in the README are regenerated by `--report` so stale numbers cannot linger.
testPlan: Fixture tree: flags a literal 'YYYY-YYYY' span in a template's static part; flags '≤ 25 km²/s²' when a constants fixture exports 25 for a C3 threshold and names that file:line as the home; does not flag `${GRID.tofMinDays}`; ignores `rgba(255,255,255,0.14)`, `max-width:731px` and import paths ending `.json`; groups `'2040-01-01'` typed in three fixture files as one duplicate group; allowlist suppresses one finding only with a non-empty reason. Reconciliation (skipped when the checkout is absent): `honesty-disclosure.ts` yields one LITERAL-WITH-UNITS containing '25 km²/s²'; `porkchop/main.ts` yields no LITERAL-DATE-SPAN in the 'Grid spans' sentence; exactly four files type `'2040-01-01'`.
landing: Aster: `tools/lint/literal-labels.mjs` with an allowlist checked into `tools/lint/`, wired into `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (which runs `node tools/run-tests.mjs` at :93). To ship: the allowlist agreed under DEC-17-5, `honesty-disclosure.ts:59` switched to a runtime read, and the four window literals folded into one shared constant (the view's 2040-01-01 end vs the cache's 2040-12-31 is S17-F2 and needs its own ruling). `src/v2/core/` untouched.
notes: Verified every cited finding: honesty-disclosure.ts:59 literal '≤ 25 km²/s²', compare/main.ts:874 runtime read, '2040-01-01' typed in porkchop/main.ts, overlay.ts, porkchop-smoke, compare/main.ts; main.ts:203/:647 already derived. Canonical over A3-06.

Every finding verified: honesty-disclosure.ts:59 literal '25 km²/s²', compare/main.ts:874,956 runtime read, main.ts:203/647 now derived (STATUS stale), '2040-01-01' in exactly four src/v2/app files; canonical over A3-06.

Every finding verified at 62ddb17: honesty-disclosure.ts:59 literal '25 km²/s²', compare/main.ts:874 runtime read, main.ts:203/647 derived span label (so STATUS item 1 is stale), '2040-01-01' typed in exactly four src/v2/app files, cache endUtc 2040-12-31. Canonical of the two DEC-17-5 linters; false positives are the real risk and the allowlist handles it.
